title: Settings
description: Your profile, account, notifications and appearance.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to your team.
profile.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
profile.name: Name
profile.bioPlaceholder: A line or two about you
profile.bioHint: Shown on your profile. Up to 160 characters.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Language and the time zone dates are shown in.

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 8 characters. You stay signed in on this device.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Removes your account and everything in it. This can't be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: Your profile, settings and data are removed for good.
delete.demo: This is a demo — nothing was deleted.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what reaches you, and where.
notifications.appDescription: In the bell at the top of every page.

orders.label: New orders
orders.hint: Each order as it comes in.

payments.label: Failed payments
payments.hint: When a card is declined or a payment bounces.

summary.label: Weekly summary
summary.hint: Sales, customers and traffic every Monday.

mentions.label: Mentions and replies
mentions.hint: When someone mentions you or answers you.

stock.label: Low stock
stock.hint: When a product falls below its low-stock level.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, dark, or whatever your device uses. Colors, radius and card style are in the theme customizer (the brush icon at the top).
